purpose: Teach: 後援/図表/台数/ターミナル/コーディネーター/歴代/三井/近況

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、文化事業の後援、私が、力を入れていた。
lines.en: In the founding days, I poured a lot of effort into supporting cultural projects.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Opens with quiet pride tempered by time's distance. Steady pace, each phrase distinct. Slight weight on the period of personal investment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社史の図表、創業者のお写真も、入れます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll include the company history chart and the founder's photograph as well.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Calm confirmation. Clear articulation—he's listening closely and taking it seriously. No rush, no performance. Grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の車の台数、当時、たった一台だったぞ。
lines.en: When the company started, we had only a single vehicle. Just one.
lines.style: Quiet amazement underneath. Slower tempo on 'single vehicle'—letting the scarcity land. Slight edge of wonder at how far they've come. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。ターミナル拠点、創業者の知恵、活かしています。
lines.en: Yes. We're putting that founder's wisdom to use every day at our terminal bases.
lines.style: Steady, purposeful. Light emphasis on 'founder's wisdom'—connecting past to present work. Composed but genuinely committed. Voice carries the weight of responsibility with ease.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 国際コーディネーター、私の代から、起用していた。
lines.en: I brought in international coordinators from my time onward. It was ahead of its time.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. A flash of quiet satisfaction in the recall. Not boasting—stating fact. Deliberate pacing, comfortable with the achievement's significance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。歴代社員の名簿、社史館に、保管しております。
lines.en: Yes. We keep records of all our past employees—their names are preserved in our company museum.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Respectful toward the legacy. Steady articulation. The word 'preserved' carries gentle weight—these people are honored, not forgotten.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 三井系のお歴々と、私も、付き合いがあった、若い頃。
lines.en: In my younger days, I had dealings with some of the Mitsui group's prominent figures.
lines.style: Softer, more personal. Nostalgic pull on 'younger days.' Eyes slightly distant, as if watching a memory. Warm but introspective. Pace slows—savoring the recall.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。OB会で、皆様の近況、お伝えしてまいります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to share everyone's news and well-wishes at our alumni gathering.
lines.style: Graceful closing. Warm, assured. The voice of someone who carries responsibility lightly. Calm finality—a promise kept. Slight nod in the voice at the end.
